title: Why Vérone Mankou Built Websites Before He Built a Tablet
conflicts: Price: planned 200,000 CFA (Global Voices, July 2011) versus actual launch price 150,000 CFA / about $300 (AFP, The World); the story uses the launch price. Funding: AFP says the project was 'essentially provided by VMK'; a popular-press claim of $700,000 of government investment has no primary source and was not used. Ages differ across reports (25, 26, '29-year-old' in 2015), so the story gives none. TechCentral says the tablet was 'released' in September 2011; AFP says it was shown then and went on sale 30 January 2012; the story follows AFP.
notes: The 80%-of-budget figure and the 'could have been profitable' remark come from an Ingenieris interview known only through Global Voices' quotation and translation; attributed accordingly. The Epictetus passage (favours bought with flattery) is applied by analogy.
